blocks.html: The data to reindex one or more search indexes.

types.name: ReindexSearchIndexesWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to reindex one or more search indexes.

children.name: index
children.description: The name of the index to reindex. Defaults to every registered index.

children.name: strategy
children.description:
How to rebuild. `swap` fills a new version and makes it active on
completion; `in_place` writes into the active version directly. Ignored
— always in place — when `filters` or `since` is set.

children.name: filters
children.description:
Filters passed to the index definition's `seed` function to rebuild only
a subset of the index's documents. The shape is index-defined.

children.name: since
children.description: Rebuilds only documents that changed at or after this date (ISO 8601).
